name: syncEHRData
shortDescription: Integrates with an external EHR system to exchange patient medical data, ensuring consistency and compliance with FHIR standards.
description:
Overview

Integrates with an external Electronic Health Record (EHR) system to exchange patient medical data. This function is typically triggered by an event (e.g., a new medical record entry or an update) and ensures data consistency and compliance with FHIR standards where applicable.

Intended use

Invoked by an event listener (e.g., onMedicalRecordUpdate) or a scheduled job to synchronize data with an external EHR system.

Logic

  1. Receive event parameters, typically including medicalRecordId or patientProfileId.
  2. Retrieve the relevant MedicalRecord and PatientProfile data using ctx.data.get.
  3. Call the external EHRSystem API (e.g., ctx.service('EHRSystem').push_medical_data(patient_data, medical_record_data)) to push or pull data. Handle API responses and potential errors.
  4. Update local MedicalRecord or PatientProfile entities if data was pulled from the EHR system.
  5. Audit-log the integration event using ctx.audit.log.
  6. Return success or error status.

Entities

  • MedicalRecord
  • PatientProfile

External Services

  • EHRSystem
